rationale: The ground-truth inline comments center on three concrete bugs: quality='fast' silently falling through to no acceleration, and two serving_video*.py sites that unconditionally overwrite `quality` instead of gating on provided_fields like their sibling num_inference_steps line. Y catches both provided_fields-guard bugs precisely (serving_video.py:203 and serving_video_output_stream.py:538, citing the exact pydantic model_fields_set semantics), while X never touches either serving file or the 'fast' fallthrough at all. Both candidates independently surface additional plausible, well-evidenced findings (custom-enabler disable() target mismatch, H200-vs-L20X hardware conflict, PR-description/code contradiction) with comparable precision and actionability, but Y's grounding in explicit code-quote evidence is slightly more rigorous. The decisive gap is recall of the actual reviewer concerns.
